conditions: Tenet Agendus never comes from a Sister of Parvos. It is not among the weapons a Sister carries, and Ergo Glast's Corrupted Holokey shop is its only source.
A shop-bought Tenet weapon enforces its MR requirement; the Sister-weapon MR bypass does not apply.

conditions: Ergo sells exactly one Agendus per 4-day rotation for 40 Holokeys. Its displayed element and 25-60% bonus reroll each rotation.
No Perrin Sequence standing is required; use Browse Merchandise in any Relay. The Tenet melee list is always in stock; only the syndicate offerings tab runs out.
The weapon is untradeable and cannot be bought with platinum.
bonuses: Take whichever element Ergo offers; Elemental Vice can change it freely once the weapon hits rank 40 (5 Forma).

groups.activity: buy Tenet Agendus on a good roll
conditions: The purchase is instant and does not use the Foundry, but it needs a free weapon slot.
Fusion sets the result to min(1.1 x the higher bonus, 60%), rounded down to one decimal; any result at 58% or higher becomes 60%.
Start the fusion from the invested Agendus and use the other as donor; the donor's Catalyst, Forma, Exilus adapter, lenses and Elemental Vice are destroyed. A second copy costs another 40 keys.

disclosures.title: the 60% chase is optional
disclosures.body: The heavy attack disk has linear falloff between 10 and 20 m and a 1.0s wind-up; it is not affected by melee-only mods like Primed Pressure Point. Take the first usable Agendus and stop chasing valence unless min-maxing is the goal.
